## Conventional Commit Prefix
<!-- Check the appropriate box so the git-cliff changelog and semver workflow trigger correctly. -->
- [ ] `feat:` (New feature - triggers minor release)
- [ ] `fix:` (Bug fix - triggers patch release)
- [ ] `perf:` (Performance improvement)
- [ ] `refactor:` (Code refactoring)
- [ ] `docs:` (Documentation updates)
- [ ] `test:` (Adding missing tests)
- [ ] `chore:` (Routine tasks, maintenance, build updates)

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] Commits are structured according to the Conventional Commits specification.
- [ ] I have verified that `make target` compiles successfully locally.
- [ ] The workflow actions (`.github/workflows`) pass all linting checks.
- [ ] Unnecessary or debug code has been removed.
